history.origins:
Country/Region of Origin: Probably China; immediate ancestor the Japanese game Dai Hin Min (Daifugō). Westernized and spread throughout the Western world (USA, Britain, Australia, France, Germany, Hungary, Denmark, Netherlands) by end of 20th century.
Time Period: Known in the West since the 1970s; climbing games long established in China.
Historical Development: Evolved from Chinese climbing games (e.g. Zheng Shangyou); Japanese Dai Hin Min is the direct ancestor; spread as a shedding game among young people.
Cultural Significance: Popular social and family game in many countries under names such as Scum, Asshole, Trouduc, Hübéres.
timeline: Modern Era: Continues to be played worldwide
